vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-054-lifecyc:
An executable observation binds the admitted absolute launcher spelling to its resolved target, streamed content digest and length, mode and same-host object identity through the incumbent SafeFS stable-file observation. Resolve that same admitted name before and after the observation and bracket preparation probes; parent and leaf links participate. Execution retains the original launcher spelling. Query performs no PATH search or probe, retains no executable bytes and imposes no raw-skill payload cap on images. Initial absence, unavailable observation and detected stale evidence are distinct. These finite checks do not promise hostile-ABA atomicity or constant I/O.

Captured client list replies remain historical unless a trusted client-state owner qualifies a finite complete read-only witness for the selected client, coordinate, scope and injected root. Bracket version/list preparation with the same witness, including selected membership and absence, and compare it for public plan, fingerprint and exported prepared observation. Drift refuses without probes or replacing historical evidence. Unqualified production Claude/Codex state returns client-state-unavailable rather than a complete current Plan; no fixture filename is a production vendor format and no HOME, credential or history scan supplies missing qualification. Local/builtin/OpenCode and owner-qualified fixture routes retain their supported positive paths. Effect transactions may consume their explicit preparation result while preserving independent apply/recover/remove admission; a public query cannot use that seam.
vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-080-machine: Successor clarification to ADAPTER-PLAN-WIRE's retained closed-reason sentence: the closed epoch-1 preparation reason vocabulary also includes client-state-unavailable and client-executable-unavailable. The former preserves historical probe evidence when no qualified finite state witness establishes currentness; the latter reports an unavailable executable observation rather than inventing absence or drift. Configured CLI and MCP publish the same typed NoEffects refusal and never refresh inside a query. Session preparation identities identify retained historical preparation; ready does not certify currentness, which every Plan must revalidate.
